studio_upload_filename: Garde Tomato Surplus - Oven Roasted Passata.mp4
capture_method: Chrome native Save Video Frame As, paused YouTube playback explicitly set to 2160p. Video DOM and saved PNG dimensions checked.
quality_note: These are decoded frames from the YouTube 4K stream, not the original camera files or a lossless source video. PNG preserves the captured pixels; YouTube compression and source focus remain.
timing_note: Times record player currentTime. Millisecond labels are navigation references, not independently measured source-video presentation timestamps.
scope: Targeted greenhouse harvest and front-facing colander sequence, approximately 4:41–5:26. Later kitchen material and the whole 19:32 video were not reviewed exhaustively in this pass.
edits: No retouching, generated content, sharpening, colour changes or upscaling. Separate review JPEGs are reduced; portrait previews crop only.
recommendation: T05 first, T02 second; T04 quieter alternative. All remain proposals.

candidates.title: Offering the harvest
candidates.strength: First choice: direct eye contact, a gentle smile and the colander held towards the viewer.
candidates.limitation: Strongest foreground fruit. Little space above the head for a large title.

candidates.title: Relaxed, front-facing
candidates.strength: A warm, open expression with the colander held comfortably at waist height.
candidates.limitation: The tomatoes are smaller in the frame than T05; the expression is mid-speech.

candidates.title: A quieter portrait
candidates.strength: A more settled stance and clear eye contact, with the fruit slightly off-centre.
candidates.limitation: Less immediate than the offered bowl; slightly open mouth.

candidates.title: Broader smile
candidates.strength: A nearby alternative to T05, with a broader smile and the bowl still prominent.
candidates.limitation: Only about one sixth of a second later; retain as an expression alternative, not a distinct composition.

candidates.title: Turned slightly towards us
candidates.strength: A less square-on stance, with a good view of the colander and greenhouse planting.
candidates.limitation: Head tilt and mid-speech expression are less composed than T05.

candidates.title: Picking among the plants
candidates.strength: A useful action alternative showing the growing context and the actual harvest.
candidates.limitation: Face turned away and fruit much smaller. Better supporting imagery than the leading portrait.
